title: Quarters: four equal parts
examples: How many quarters make a whole?

explain.say: Imagine a birthday cake in Mexico City, and 4 friends want equal slices. Look at the board: the cake is cut into 4 equal parts. The shaded part is one quarter.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: fractions of a pie. Can you see the whole pie and the one slice? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Now 2 of the 4 parts are shaded. That is 2 quarters. Look closely: 2 quarters cover exactly half of the cake! Can you see it?
Here 3 parts are shaded: three quarters. Only 1 quarter is left. We write it 3 over 4: 4 equal parts, and we have 3 of them. How many quarters fill the whole cake?
All 4 quarters are shaded, so we have one whole cake. 4 quarters make 1 whole. A quarter is also called a fourth. Is a quarter bigger or smaller than a half?

Wonderful! You can find a quarter of a group too: 12 sweets shared between 4 is 3 each, so a quarter of 12 is 3. Wow: a quarter of an hour is 15 minutes, because an hour has 60! Can you find a quarter of 8?

faq.a: A quarter is one of 4 equal parts. Cut a cake into 4 equal slices, and each slice is one quarter.

faq.q: How many quarters make a whole?
faq.a: 4 quarters make one whole. Put all 4 equal slices together and you have the whole cake again.
Three quarters means 3 of the 4 equal parts. It is written 3 over 4, and only one quarter is missing.

faq.q: Is a quarter bigger or smaller than a half?
faq.a: Smaller. A half is 1 of 2 parts, but a quarter is 1 of 4 parts. Cutting into more parts makes each piece smaller. Two quarters make one half.
asks: Which is bigger, a half or a quarter?

faq.q: How do I find a quarter of 12?
faq.a: Share 12 into 4 equal groups. Each group has 3, so a quarter of 12 is 3. Or halve 12 to get 6, then halve again to get 3.

facts: 4 quarters make 1 whole, and 2 quarters make 1 half.
A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes.

quiz.say: How many quarters make one half?
quiz.show: How many quarters make one half?
quiz.why: A half is 2 of the 4 equal parts, so 2 quarters make one half.

wrong.1: 4 quarters make one whole, not a half.
wrong.2: 1 quarter is only half of a half.

quiz.why: 20 shared into 4 equal groups is 5 each.

wrong.0: 4 is the number of groups, not how many are in each.
wrong.2: 10 is half of 20, not a quarter.
